excerpt: AI coding assistant in your editor. Create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval.
Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
Autonomous execution can modify files and run commands without further prompts.
Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
The same Cline experience in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and the rest of the JetBrains family.
Any ACP-capable client can use Cline as its coding agent without a dedicated extension
Subagents let Cline spawn focused research agents that run in parallel.
Skills are modular instruction sets that extend Cline's capabilities for specific tasks.
YOLO mode is Auto Approve on steroids. Check the box and Cline auto-approves everything
Plan mode lets you explore and strategize without changing files. Act mode executes against your plan.
You can configure separate models for Plan and Act modes.
The CLI supports running agents on cron schedules through the hub.
In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert.
Executes in your terminal and reacts to output as it appears. Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.
You're never locked into our platform or pricing. Switch providers or self-host anytime.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Cline use external tools and data sources through MCP servers.
Chat with the agent from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear. Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
